name: UptimeRobot
author: duckcove
description: Operator view of an UptimeRobot account: monitor groups, the error text of a failed check, a bar circle that is green while everything is up and red when something breaks, and a notification when it turns red.

barWidget.description: Operator view of an UptimeRobot account

schema.label: Poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to ask UptimeRobot for the latest status. Each poll is one request plus one per 50 monitors; the free plan allows 10 a minute.

schema.label: Grace period (seconds)
schema.description: How long a monitor must stay Down, or UptimeRobot unreachable, before the bar turns red and you are notified.
